security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by documentation snippets, fixtures, Markdown backticks, and generated test import templates. I found no executed command, network request, environment read, or hidden-file read path in the reviewed code. However, evaluation_output.json embeds prior safety verdicts that can bias AI reviewers, so the package needs remediation before publication.

remediation.issue: Prior audit verdicts are bundled in the skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove evaluation_output.json from the distributed skill, or replace safety verdict text with neutral fixture data that cannot influence reviewers.

content.user_title: Generate Better Tests with TDD Guidance
content.value_statement: Teams often miss edge cases and coverage gaps when tests are written late. This skill generates focused tests, analyzes coverage, and guides TDD cycles across major frameworks.
actual_capabilities: Generates unit test cases from user stories, acceptance criteria, API descriptions, and source code context.
Creates Jest, Vitest, Pytest, JUnit, and Mocha test scaffolds with framework-specific structure.
Parses LCOV, JSON, and XML coverage reports to find line, branch, and function gaps.
Scores test quality using assertion counts, isolation heuristics, naming checks, and test smell detection.
Guides red-green-refactor cycles with phase validation and next-step recommendations.
limitations: It does not run tests, install dependencies, or verify generated code against your runtime.
Coverage analysis depends on coverage reports supplied by the user.
Best language support is for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Java.
Generated tests need human review for domain rules and project conventions.

use_cases.title: Create Unit Tests
use_cases.description: Generate framework-specific tests from source code and acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Coverage Gaps
use_cases.description: Turn LCOV, JSON, or XML coverage reports into ranked test recommendations.

use_cases.title: Coach TDD Adoption
use_cases.description: Guide red, green, and refactor phases for new features.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one function or class.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate Jest tests for this function. Cover happy path, validation errors, and boundary cases. [paste code]

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Coverage Gaps
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using an existing coverage report.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze coverage/lcov.info for this project. List the top five gaps and suggest tests for each gap.

prompt_templates.title: Run a TDD Cycle
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for a new feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide a red-green-refactor cycle for a password validator. Start with failing tests, then implementation checks, then refactor advice.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Test Frameworks
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these Jest tests to Pytest while preserving behavior, fixture setup, assertions, and coverage intent. Explain any changed test patterns.

output_examples.input: Generate tests for a discount calculation function.
output: A focused test plan covering valid discounts, invalid rates, zero values, and rounding behavior.
Framework-specific scaffold names and setup guidance for the selected test runner.
A short review checklist for assertions, fixtures, and boundary coverage.

output_examples.input: Analyze coverage for an authentication module.
output: Coverage summary for lines, branches, and functions against the requested threshold.
Priority recommendations for uncovered login failures, expired sessions, and lockout paths.
Suggested next tests grouped by critical, important, and optional work.

output_examples.input: Guide TDD for a user registration feature.
output: A red-phase checklist for failing tests before implementation starts.
Green-phase validation steps for the smallest passing implementation.
Refactor prompts focused on naming, duplication, and test readability.

best_practices: Provide requirements and source code together so generated tests target observable behavior.
Review generated tests before adding them to a repository.
Use coverage recommendations to prioritize critical paths before minor branches.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad test generation without naming the framework and target behavior.
Do not treat generated coverage recommendations as a substitute for product risk review.
Do not execute generated tests without checking imports, fixtures, and data assumptions.

faq.question: Does this skill execute tests?
faq.answer: No. It generates guidance and test scaffolds, but test execution remains in your project environment.

faq.question: Which frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: It includes patterns for Jest, Vitest, Pytest, JUnit, Mocha, and related test styles.

faq.question: Can it analyze coverage reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can interpret LCOV, JSON, and XML coverage data supplied by the user.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content is written for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Can generated tests be committed directly?
faq.answer: Review them first. Confirm imports, fixtures, business rules, and project conventions before committing.

faq.question: Is it useful for integration or end-to-end tests?
faq.answer: It can suggest scenarios, but it is strongest for unit tests and coverage-driven planning.
